run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways to partition a set of n elements into k subsets
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that calculates Stirling numbers of the second kind
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a 1D DP array instead of a 2D table for memory efficiency
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function recurrence relation dp[i][j] = j*dp[i-1][j] + dp[i-1][j-1]
